generated_from: working tree at inventory creation; hashes pin indexed inputs

productions.name: app_implicit
productions.production: app_implicit    = line("app" NAME app_attributes) [context] {line(import {";" import})} sections ;

productions.name: context_declaration
productions.production: context_declaration = "theme" attributes | "files" attributes | "locale" attributes | "binding" NAME "DurableObject" attributes | "queue" NAME attributes | "cache" "KV" attributes | "analytics" NAME schema ;

productions.name: app_attributes
productions.production: app_attributes  = attributes with uses present for app_composed and absent for app_implicit ;

productions.name: type_base
productions.production: type_base        = path {"|" path} | enum_type | action_type | delivery_type | invocation_type ;

productions.name: primary
productions.production: primary        = INTEGER | DECIMAL | DURATION | BYTES | STRING [message_variants] | "true" | "false" | "null" | VALUE_NAME | "(" expr ")" | array | values | typed_value ;

productions.name: call_expr
productions.production: call_expr      = postfix with a final arguments suffix ;

productions.name: given_leaf
productions.production: given_leaf     = corpus | preferences | ["export"] (model | contract | event | role | pure_function | fixture | message) | ordinary_given ;

productions.name: ordinary_given
productions.production: ordinary_given = derive_field | policy | invariant | unique | lock | retain ;

productions.name: judgment_leaf
productions.production: judgment_leaf  = NAME "noul" caption ["yes" "=" caption "no" "=" caption] | NAME "choice" caption (judgment_choices | "options" "=" "runtime" [judgment_choices]) | NAME "score" caption "[" separated(judgment_option) [","] "]" ;

productions.name: when_items
productions.production: when_items      = {line(crud_head {";" crud_head}) | crud_head suite(crud_examples) | user_scenario | trusted_scenario} ;

productions.name: effect_leaf
productions.production: effect_leaf     = let | guard | create | set | delete | call | emit | send | schedule | cancel | return ;

productions.name: expected_error
productions.production: expected_error    = call_expr with bare callee "error" and exactly one argument ;

productions.name: example_call
productions.production: example_call      = "call" ordinary values "by" "=" example_caller ["request" "=" values] ["as" NAME] ["->" expected_error] ;

productions.name: core_ui_item
productions.production: core_ui_item   = line(ui_leaves) | ui_group | collection | form | tabs_group ;

productions.name: ui_leaf
productions.production: ui_leaf        = "require" expr | "title" expr | "text" observations | "content" observations | "metrics" observations | "copy" expr | "edit" attributes | "delete" | "action" expr | "actions" separated(expr) | "history" | collection_header | form_header | "tabs" expr ;

productions.name: ui_group
productions.production: ui_group       = "card" expr attributes suite(ui_body) | "details" expr attributes suite(ui_body) ;
